housing-numbers.notes: Target is at least 7,600 homes 2011-2031. Already 2,351 completed/permitted by 2015. Allocated sites total 5,604 including 2,950 town centre, 1,350 west of Stevenage, 1,350 north/south-east new neighbourhoods, plus smaller sites. Windfall is 20 per year after 2021 = 200 total. Annual target calculated as 450 homes/year for remainder of plan period but overall requirement averages 380/year.
